title: ordo v1
description: Frozen contract for the ordo change-ordering engine. Input and output for `ordo order --json`.

full_context.description: assert each change's `diff` is a complete (full-context) patch so a modified file can be reconstructed for full semantics; else a diff-only modification is positional

only_comments.description: drop every non-comment/docstring hunk before ordering, so order/files/groups/edges/clusters cover only comment-only hunks

rules.description: reviewing rules: the caller's own conventions, matched against the facts the engine computes. The engine reads no rule files — a client collects them (per-user, per-repo) and passes them here, so `ordo order` stays a function of its arguments

when.description: conditions, ANDed; an empty `when` matches every hunk

lang.description: language name as `src/lang.rs` knows it; a list matches any of them, since one construct is often one rule across a family

defines.description: glob against any name the hunk defines

kind.description: node kind(s) the hunk introduces — a string or a list

with.description: child kinds or keyword tokens the matched node must have

without.description: child kinds or keyword tokens the matched node must lack

text.description: regex the matched node's text must match

text_not.description: regex the matched node's text must not match

path_not.description: glob the file path must not match

test.description: whether the file is a test path (`tests/`, `test_*`, `*_spec.*`, …); `test = false` is how a rule says production code only

max_params.description: fires when a definition the hunk introduces takes more parameters

max_lines.description: fires when a definition the hunk introduces is longer

max_nesting.description: fires when a row of the hunk sits deeper in control flow

max_file_lines.description: fires on the hunks of a file this change pushed past the limit

max_nesting_delta.description: fires when a definition the hunk touched nests control flow deeper than its old version by more than this

max_lines_delta.description: fires when a definition the hunk touched grew longer than its old version by more than this

max_params_delta.description: fires when a definition the hunk touched gained more parameters than this

max_branches_delta.description: fires when a definition the hunk touched gained more branches (if, loops, match/switch) than this

max_cognitive_delta.description: fires when a definition the hunk touched grew in cognitive complexity (branches weighted by nesting, plus boolean operator runs) by more than this

max_short_names_delta.description: fires when a definition the hunk touched grew its share of one- or two-character local names by more than this many percentage points

recursive.description: a definition starting in the hunk calls itself

container_with.description: glob some member of the hunk's container must match

container_without.description: glob no member of the hunk's container may match

member_uninitialized.description: the hunk adds a data member nothing in the change initializes

query.description: tree-sitter query source; only rows inside the hunk count, so a rule fires on what the change introduces rather than on everything the file already contained

verdict.description: a concrete downgrade this rule asserts rather than an FYI — reported at `verdict` level, the same level the construct catalog uses when a signal backs the call

noise.description: treat a matching hunk as skippable

priority.description: ordering influence: higher sorts earlier, but only among hunks the dependency graph has already freed — a preference can never reorder a definition after its use

catalog.description: whether the built-in construct catalog runs; true by default — it is what a reviewer gets with no configuration

docs_last.description: sort docs-only (prose) hunks after the code they describe; true by default — data and config files keep their place

disable.description: rule names not to report, as globs; applied to the catalog as well as to `rules`

levels.description: a level per rule name, replacing the one a catalog entry or one of `rules` was written with; the finding records the old one in `original_level`, and a name nothing reports under is a problem

hunch.description: put a trained model's guess on every hunk (`hunks[].hunch`): P(skip), P(faithful rationale) and attention, each with the features that moved it most. When the shipped skip head passed its promotion gate, a confident guess also moves the hunk's `noise` flag (`hunks[].hunch.changed`); P(faithful) changes nothing; when the attention head passed its gate, the `comprehension` strategy orders the groups the def->use order freed by their highest attention, in place of file position only (a rule's `priority` and `docs_last` still win, a use never precedes its definition). Its history features read `history`

consumers.description: files outside the change that call into it, e.g. another repository importing this one; read only as callers for the contract checks, never ordered or output

path.description: how a note names the file

history.description: what the repository did before the change, for `options.hunch`: the change's ancestors only, never the change itself or anything after it, with the paths each touched under their names at the change (follow renames). The engine counts those inside 90 days before `at`. Absent when no repository is behind the change, such as a diff on stdin

at.description: the change's own commit time, Unix seconds

degraded.description: true when the file could only be ordered positionally (a diff without full context); omitted when false

unsupported.description: true when the file's extension has no tree-sitter grammar, so hunks carry no structural analysis; omitted when false

dropped.description: hunks removed before ordering (only `only_comments` removes any: an import hunk is kept and marked noise); hunks + dropped is what the diff produced, so a consumer can prove nothing went missing silently; omitted when empty

enclosing_kind.description: what `enclosing` names when it is not a plain definition: a named block (a test suite) or a region that holds the hunk but declares nothing (a conditional-compilation block, a document preamble or its front matter, a top-level binding or call whose multi-line value or arguments hold the hunk). A region name is never a symbol and never seeds a def→use edge; omitted for a definition

noise.description: formatting-only or generated-file hunk, skippable for review; omitted when false

extent.description: how much of the hunk changed: layout only (whitespace, formatting), most of its old text kept (edited) or replaced (rewritten), or one side empty (added, removed); omitted on a degraded file

comment.description: every changed line is a comment or docstring; drives `only_comments` filtering; omitted when false

details.description: what the hunk did to the members of its enclosing container, e.g. "adds Serve, Watch to Cli"; omitted when empty

notes.description: structural smells for a def introduced here (size/nesting/params); omitted when empty

deltas.description: the definitions this hunk is the first to touch whose readability measurements moved, each measurement as [old, new]; what the `max_*_delta` rule conditions compare. A definition the change adds or renames has no old version and is not here. Omitted when empty

name.description: qualified name, the same on both sides

nesting.description: deepest control flow inside it, counted from its own body

cognitive.description: each branch weighted by how deep it sits, plus each run of `&&`/`||`

short_names.description: percent of its local names one or two characters long

hunch.description: a trained model's guess, when `options.hunch` asked for it: it may move the hunk's `noise` flag (see `changed`) and, by `attention`, the order of groups the def->use order left free. Omitted otherwise

noise.description: P(a reviewer can skip this hunk), to four decimals; beside the engine's own `noise` flag, not instead of it

top.description: up to three features that moved the guess most, as [feature, contribution]: the contribution is in log-odds, positive toward skipping, largest first by size

changed.description: how the guess moved this hunk's `noise` flag: `unhid` clears a flag the engine set (P(skip) under the model's un-hide threshold), `hid` sets one it left clear (P(skip) at its hide threshold or above). Only from a model that passed its promotion gate; omitted when the flag stands

faithful.description: P(the hunk's rationale and details state nothing false or misleading about it), to four decimals; a shadow guess that changes nothing

faithful_top.description: up to three features that moved `faithful` most, as `top` is for `noise`: positive toward a faithful rationale

attention.description: how much the hunk needs a reviewer's attention, 0 to 1 (the expected 1-3 rating rescaled), to four decimals; orders the groups the def->use order freed only when the attention head passed its gate

attention_top.description: up to three features that moved `attention` most, as `top` is for `noise`: positive toward attention

symbols.description: symbol identity (name + tree-sitter node kind + enclosing scope) for each definition this hunk introduces, e.g. distinguishing a method `run` on class `A` from a module-level function `run`; matches `defines` minus imports; omitted when empty

kind.description: raw tree-sitter node kind of the defining node, e.g. function_definition

scope.description: qualified enclosing-definition name at the point of definition, or null at top level

findings.description: everything anyone noticed about this hunk, whoever noticed it: the engine's advanced-construct catalog (P14), the caller's reviewing rules, and — when a client merges them — an external analyzer's results. Omitted when empty

name.description: the construct, rule or analyzer check that fired

level.description: `verdict` is v1's `advisories[].verdict: true` — a concrete downgrade with a signal behind it

row.description: 1-based new-side row the finding is anchored at; omitted when it is about the hunk as a whole

original_level.description: the level the finding was written with, present only when `options.levels` moved it to `level`

uses_at.description: where each name this hunk introduces is used, as new-side rows rather than prose; omitted when empty

files.description: the files a same-edit group spans — the one group that may leave a file or a scope: its members are one edit (the same lines removed and added, each trimmed, or the same run of tokens swapped) repeated across them, read together. Omitted for every other group.

problems.description: what the engine could not make sense of in the caller's own input — a rule whose glob or query does not compile. Reported rather than silently never matching; omitted when empty

clusters.description: independent parts of the change (connected components of the group def→use graph); each is an array of hunk ids. One cluster = atomic; multiple = candidate PR split.

notes.description: P13.2 changeset notes: change-shape signals about the change as a whole, as facts rather than judgments — `code changed but no test touched`, `a.py: 14 hunks (high churn)`. Omitted when empty. Per-hunk signals live on hunks[].notes.

summary.description: The change as a whole, read off the hunks' facts by fixed rules: a label, whether it preserves behaviour, and two sentences saying why. Omitted when the change has no hunks.

label.description: docs / test / chore when no code file changed, by which files did; refactor when every code hunk preserves behaviour (docs when every one is a comment, test when a test changed alongside); fix-candidate for a guard, try, narrowed, widened or inverted condition, or boundary edit, or for edited code with a test changed alongside; feature for new definitions; change when no rule holds

verdict.description: preserving only when every hunk proves it (formatting, a comment, a rename, a move, a reordering, an extraction, a literal named as its constant); changes when an edit pattern or a changed value shows it; unknown otherwise

sentences.description: what the label rests on, then what the verdict rests on

regressions.description: the definitions the change made hardest to read, each with the measurements that grew against its own old version (nesting, cognitive complexity, branches, params, short-name share, lines). Omitted when no touched definition got harder to read.

ledger.description: P23.1 change ledger: one entry per symbol the change touches, in reading order, rather than per hunk. A projection of data already present elsewhere in this output. Omitted when empty.

kind.description: tree-sitter kind of the defining node; absent for a removed symbol, whose node no longer exists

from.description: the old name (renamed), the source path (moved), or the definition it came out of (extracted)

used_by.description: ids of hunks in this change that use it — the fan-in; empty is itself a signal

at.description: id of the hunk this entry is anchored to — the one that defines it, or deletes it
